title: Business hours
content: We're open Monday through Saturday, 8am to 9pm, and Sunday 10am to 6pm local time. Pharmacy consultation hours are 9am to 7pm on weekdays.

title: Resetting your account password
content: To reset your password, open the login page and select 'Forgot password', then follow the link sent to your registered email. The link expires after 30 minutes.

title: Mobile app availability
content: Yes, our mobile app is available for iOS and Android. It lets you manage prescriptions, book appointments, and track orders from your phone.

title: How to contact us
content: You can reach us by phone, live chat on our website, or email support. Phone support has the shortest wait times during weekday mornings.

title: Loyalty program
content: Our loyalty program gives you one point per dollar spent, redeemable for discounts on future orders. Sign-up is free and points are tracked automatically on your account.

title: Requesting a prescription refill
content: You can request a refill through the app, website, or by calling the pharmacy directly with your prescription number. Most refills are ready within two hours.

title: Delivery coverage area
content: We currently deliver within a 25-mile radius of each store location. Enter your zip code at checkout to confirm delivery availability in your area.

title: Curbside pickup
content: Curbside pickup is available at all locations. Place your order online, select curbside at checkout, and call the store number when you arrive in the parking lot.

title: Insurance accepted
content: We accept most major insurance plans for prescription medications. You can add your insurance information to your account or bring your card in-store.

title: Tracking an order
content: You can track any order by logging into your account and opening the Order Status page, or using the tracking link sent in your confirmation email.

title: Creating an account
content: Creating an account takes about a minute — you'll need your name, email, and a phone number for order and appointment notifications.

title: Saving multiple addresses
content: You can save multiple delivery addresses in your account settings and choose which one to use at checkout for each order.

title: Gift cards
content: Gift cards are available in-store and online in denominations from $10 to $200. They don't expire and can be combined with other payment methods.

title: Price matching
content: We match prices on identical, in-stock items from major local competitors. Bring proof of the competitor's price at checkout or contact support after purchase.

title: Out-of-stock notifications
content: If an item is out of stock, you can click 'Notify Me' on the product page and we'll email you as soon as it's back in stock.

title: Finding a store
content: Use the store locator on our website or app to find the nearest location, its hours, and whether it has a pharmacy counter.

title: Language support
content: Customer support and the pharmacy consultation line are available in English and Spanish. Additional languages are available through phone interpretation on request.

title: Accessibility services
content: Our stores offer wheelchair-accessible entrances and checkout counters, and large-print prescription labels are available on request at any pharmacy counter.

title: Giving feedback or filing a complaint
content: You can leave feedback through the app, website contact form, or by speaking with a team member. Formal complaints are logged and followed up on within two business days.

title: Changing an order after placing it
content: You can add items or change quantities within 30 minutes of placing an order by contacting support. Once an order enters processing, changes are no longer possible.

title: Getting a copy of a receipt
content: Digital receipts for every order and pharmacy purchase are available under Order History in your account, and can be resent to your email at any time.
